description: This file contains the implementation of the 'mrp.procurement' class with methods for procurement confirmation, automatic procurement creation, and order point confirmation in an Odoo (OpenERP) module related to manufacturing resource planning.

classes.name: mrp_procurement
classes.description: Class extending 'mrp.procurement' with methods for procurement confirmation, automatic procurement creation, and order point confirmation.

methods.name: _procure_confirm
methods.description: Confirms procurement orders, validates workflows, and generates a procurement report.

methods.name: create_automatic_op
methods.description: Automatically creates procurement orders for products with negative virtual stock in warehouses.

methods.name: _procure_orderpoint_confirm
methods.description: Confirms procurement orders based on stock order points, optionally creating automatic procurement orders.
